searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py and work/comps.py: '14ct gold chain', 'serpentine chain gold', 'gold neck chain 14ct'. Plain 14ct chain hits are mostly chains with pendants; only one serpentine chain comp (18ct). No bare 14ct S-link chain comp with weight.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold/completed: '14ct gold serpentine chain' and '14k gold S link chain necklace' (match weight in grams; fine S-link chains usually 3-6g). Terapeak: '14ct yellow gold serpentine chain'. Also Noble Numismatics archive 'gold serpentine chain', Leonard Joel and Theodore Bruce 'gold chain 14ct' results. Also check the current AUD spot gold price for scrap value per gram (14ct is 58.3% gold).
viewing_check: Find the karat stamp on the clasp ring or jump ring (14, 585, 9ct 375 or none). Weigh the chain in grams and measure length; value is weight x karat. Acid-test if allowed. Check for kinks or repairs. Colour looks slightly yellow-green, so confirm it is not gold-filled or plated.
rate_note: All prices are AUD hammer, no conversion needed.
